reviews.reasons: Every link of the golf audit is evidenced on this offer's own record: $400 is what these buyers paid (15 payment records 2026-11-03..11-21), conversion 15/100 = 15% on this offer's own sales, 180 public courses in the association directory, Brain produces the spreadsheet (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $5 cost, $0 tied up, cash usable in 5 days. Arithmetic recomputed: 8 audits reach $3,000 ($3,200); plan 9 x $400 = $3,600 gross, 9 x $5 = $45 cost, spent day 9 after receipts settle day 9, so no owner capital (exposure cap $0 holds). Proof day 15 inside 30. Stance EXECUTABLE is right and the youth-soccer workbook (21/140 = 15% at $180, 420 leagues) is a correctly evidenced fallback.
findings: Reach pool: the first outreach already contacted 100 of the 180 directory courses (15 bought a one-time audit; MARKET_VOLUME counts one purchase each). Only ~80 uncontacted courses remain, not 100. At 15% that is ~12 expected orders vs 9 needed (needs 11.3% conversion; roughly 85% chance on a binomial at the measured rate). The target still holds in expectation, but the step should email the ~80 uncontacted courses, and the margin is thinner than 'expected 15' suggests.

Hedge: running the youth-soccer workbook in parallel (280 uncontacted leagues x 15% = ~42 expected at $180) costs nothing extra and would cover a golf shortfall within the window; recommend starting it if golf orders are below ~6 by day 7 rather than holding it as a pure fallback.
SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; connect before day 1 (setup, not an evidential unknown).

reviews.reasons: Contract v2 limits the goal to youth sports leagues; the golf audit is correctly excluded by the owner's terms (industry: public golf courses) and the soccer workbook is the only opening inside them. Every link is evidenced on the workbook's own record: $180 is what these treasurers paid (21 payment records 2026-11-05..11-24), 21/140 = 15% conversion on this offer's own sales, 420 leagues in the association directory closing fall books in December, Brain produces the spreadsheet, $4 cost, $0 tied up, cash in 5 days. Arithmetic recomputed: 17 sales reach $3,000 ($3,060); plan 18 x $180 = $3,240, cost 18 x $4 = $72 spent day 9 after receipts settle day 9 (no capital, exposure cap $0 holds); proof day 15 inside 30. 18 from 140 contacts needs 12.9% vs measured 15% (expected 21).
findings: Margin: at 140 contacts the binomial chance of >= 17 sales at 15% is only about 80% (mean 21, sd ~4.2). The first outreach used 140 of the 420 leagues, leaving ~280 uncontacted; emailing all of them costs nothing and gives ~42 expected sales, making the target near-certain. Recommend reaching the full uncontacted pool (and excluding the 21 prior buyers, a one-time purchase) rather than stopping at 140.
